title: fix(objectql,approvals,audit): rule messages, approval object labels and activity-summary labels read as /meta serves them in a declared sourceLocale
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb3T2gwH6MWTYde4qF8edEDN)_

Part of #35384 — this PR moves three of the card's readers onto the `/meta` resolve path. The approval NOTIFICATION subject param stays open: it is resolved per recipient at delivery by service-messaging's general keyed-param path, so it is left for the area to file (see Acceptance notes).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:应用以英文编写、默认面向中文用户时，英文用户在审批收件箱、审批页、活动记录摘要和自定义校验规则的报错里看到英文原文，不再夹杂默认语言的中文;中文用户看到的不变。
- 为什么做:这是多语言标签统一的后续:让这三处和对象元数据接口用同一种方式取标签。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是某处标签显示成原文而不是译文，不影响数据和权限，合并后可直接回退。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

The #34030 rule, quoted from the card: "resolve the label through `translateObject` with the same resolve options `/meta` builds, so `t()` carries messages only."

- **objectql** (`validation/rule-validator.ts`, `authoredRuleMessage`): an author-written rule message (`objects.OBJECT._validations.RULE.message`) now resolves through `translatedLabels` over `ValidationMessageContext.labelTranslation`. That is the bundle plus `ResolveOptions` that the same refusal's field, option and object labels already read (#34030), so this half adds no copy of the options. The ADR-0029 D9.2a tenant-rewrite check is unchanged. `translate` (that is, `t()`) now carries only the built-in messages.
- **plugin-approvals** (`reader-locale-labels.ts`, `readerLabelsFor().objectLabel`): the object label resolves through `translateObject` over every locale the service holds, with the metadata route's options: the negotiated reader locale, the declared fallback chain, and `sourceLocale` else `defaultLocale`. This one change covers the inbox row, the request page, the generic data door's request rows and the two lifecycle refusals that name an object. Flow, step and position labels and the catalog sentences stay on `t()`.
- **plugin-audit** (`activity-summary-message.ts`): `readerSummaryLocale` hands the composer the object definition that `translateObject` put in the reader's language. The object, field and select-option labels are read off that definition and no longer come from `t()` keys. The writer's stored sentence is unchanged, because its locale already reads only authored labels.
- A service that cannot hand its translations over (no `getLocales()` / `getTranslations()`) no longer gets these labels translated through `t()`: the authored text stands. Every service the platform ships implements both.

## Tests

- objectql `engine-label-source-locale.test.ts`: new top-level describe for the authored rule message under `sourceLocale: 'en'` / `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'`. An `en` write reads the authored sentence. Controls: a `zh-CN` write reads the zh-CN row, and with no `sourceLocale` an `en` write walks to the zh-CN row.
- objectql `validation/rule-validator.test.ts` (#14253 and D9.2a describes) moved from `translate` doubles to `labelTranslation`. The first case wires a `t()` decoy beside it, so a regression back to `t()` turns it red.
- objectql `engine-validation-locale-negotiation.test.ts` and `engine-validation-tenant-rewrite.test.ts`: the served-adapter doubles gain `getTranslations` / `getFallbackLocale`, which `FileI18nAdapter` has. The three `t()`-locale probes in the negotiation suite now trip a built-in `max_length` message, the sentence the `t()` bridge still carries.
- plugin-approvals `reader-locale-labels.test.ts` and plugin-audit `activity-summary-message.test.ts`: a new `[#35384]` describe in each. Each covers the real in-memory service and the served-adapter shape, and asserts that `t()` itself answers the zh-CN row at the same service, so the defect's precondition is measured and not assumed. Also covered: the two controls, a `t()`-only service, and a throwing `getTranslations`.
- `/meta`'s half of the same scenario is pinned in `packages/rest/src/meta-i18n-declared-fallback-chain.test.ts` §6.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not fixed here, left for the area to file:** the approval notification subject param (`approval-notification-text.ts` `subjectParams`, `{ key: objects.OBJECT.label, fallback }`). It is resolved at delivery by `packages/services/service-messaging/src/notification-text.ts` (`renderWith`: `lookup(i18n, param.key, locale) ?? param.fallback`, through `t()`). The producer holds no recipient locale at emit, so it cannot hand over a resolved label. The only messaging fix would parse the key shape inside the per-delivery param resolver that every producer's keyed params share, which goes past the narrow widening the area allowed. **Routed (seat):** this is the #35384 remainder, released back to `pm:queue` on merge as a typed object-label param in `NotificationTextKeys` that service-messaging resolves through `translateObject` (`domain:server`), together with `readerLabelsFor`'s flow, step and position labels.
- **Folded into the same #35384 remainder (L1 7081082388):** the two readers this PR moves hand `translateObject` the metadata route's resolve options but not its packaged base. plugin-approvals `objectLabel` passes `{ name }` alone, and plugin-audit `translatedObjectDef` passes no `packagedBase`. So for a renamed object (a served label that diverged from the packaged one) they read the translation of the old label, where `/meta` serves the rename. This is not a regression: `t('objects.<o>.label')` did the same. The fix is the `getPackagedObjectBase` read #36460 threads for the share-link label. Until then, the docblocks' "as `/meta` resolves it" holds for the resolve options only.
- **Measured: `en-US` under `sourceLocale: 'en'`.** `/meta` hands `translateObject` the request tag as written. objectql (#34030) and now these readers hand it the tag negotiated against the service's locales. When the service holds an `en` locale (any `en` catalog), an `en-US` request gets `客户` (the defaultLocale row) from `/meta` and `Account` from objectql. With no `en` locale held, both give `客户`. Reading taken with `translateObject` from this branch's `@objectstack/spec` dist at c0111e2ed. Raised as a decision; not changed here. **Filed:** #36466 (`/meta` negotiates the request locale first; no spec change).
- No resolve-options builder is reachable from plugin-approvals or plugin-audit: rest's `metaTranslateOptions` is not a dependency, and objectql's `labelTranslationOf` is private. So each plugin carries the same few lines that plugin-security and objectql inlined in #34030, with a docblock naming `metaTranslateOptions`. **Filed:** #36467 (one exported spec builder, contract tier).

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/reader-locale-labels.test.ts`. Expect every case to pass, including `[#35384] … an en reader picks no defaultLocale row`.

Read first:
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-summary-message.ts`, the `readerSummaryLocale` / `translatedObjectDef` hunk (the reader's definitions are now the translated ones).
2. `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts`, the `authoredRuleMessage` hunk.
3. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/reader-locale-labels.ts`, the `objectLabel` hunk.

<details><summary>Test readings (b81511248 unless stated; fix round at final head 67d23afa2 first)</summary>

- Fix round at 67d23afa2 (CI Test Core 6/10 red on b81511248: 4 cases in `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-write-refusal-locale.integration.test.ts`, whose i18n double held the rule message only as a `t()` key, so the bundle read now returned the authored English). The double's zh-CN bundle gains `objects.crm_deal._validations.amount_not_negative.message`. It is a fixture change of spelling only: no assertion changed and nothing was skipped. In that file, Tests 8 passed (8). `@objectstack/service-automation` 290/290 files, 4222/4222 tests. `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` 126/126 files, 1853/1853. `@objectstack/plugin-audit` 109/109 files, 1800/1800. Lock VERDICT command-exit 0. overlap-check at 67d23afa2 is clean. A sweep of the other tests that combine validations, an i18n service and a non-en locale found no further consumer.
- objectql `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` at 8be4929bd (objectql is unchanged after it): Test Files 628 passed (628), Tests 14286 passed (14286); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- plugin-audit `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test` at b61713eeb: 107/109 files, 1798/1800 tests. Two failures: the new pin's expected list wording, and the bare-string option case (triaged below). After the fix, those two files at b81511248: Tests 31 passed (31).
- plugin-approvals `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test` at b61713eeb: 125/126 files, 1846/1853 tests. Seven failures, all in `record-lock-user-facing-message.test.ts`, whose doubles answered labels through `t()` only. After those doubles gained `getTranslations`, that file and `reader-locale-labels.test.ts` at b81511248: Tests 41 passed (41).
- typecheck at b81511248: objectql exit 0, plugin-audit exit 0, plugin-approvals exit 0. At b61713eeb approvals failed with TS2339 on the label-only doc literal; fixed with an `ObjectLike` annotation.
- Fixture triage: the bare-string option `options: ['p1', 'p2']` is not a `SelectOptionSchema` (strict object with `label`). `translateObject`, and so `/meta`, serves it as written. The #7289 case now pins `p1` as `/meta` serves it, where it used to pin the `t()` row.

</details>

<details><summary>Reverse verification (each fixed source file put back to origin/main, its pins run, then restored)</summary>

At b61713eeb, under one lock call, the scratch script used `git restore --source=BASE` (tree only), checked the BASE blob hash on disk, then `git checkout HEAD --` and checked the HEAD blob hash. Pins resolve `src/` directly, so no dist step is involved.
- `rule-validator.ts` at BASE: `engine-label-source-locale.test.ts` 1 failed / 8 (`an en write reads the authored English sentence`).
- `reader-locale-labels.ts` at BASE: `reader-locale-labels.test.ts` 4 failed / 22 (both `en reader picks no defaultLocale row` cases, the inbox-row case, and the `t()`-only case).
- `activity-summary-message.ts` at BASE: `activity-summary-message.test.ts` 4 failed / 18 (both `en reader` cases, the `t()`-only case, and the throwing-translations case).
- Controls stayed green on every leg. After restore, `git diff HEAD` was empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 74 families; reconciliation with `--ran` reported 74 derived, 74 run.
- 70 exit 0 at b61713eeb. Re-run at b81511248, exit 0: `check:type-check-debt` (a PREREQUISITE exit 3 on the first pass, while a sibling build held dist), `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:issue-citations`.
- NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI: `check:i18n` (needs the built CLI closure), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs a full build), and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (needs a commit this shallow clone does not have).
- `overlap-check --branch=HEAD`: clean against origin/main and #36399.

</details>
